objective: Make the development-flow KGI/KPI framework decision-grade by closing every MUST, SHOULD, and COULD finding in the bound independent review in one semantically validated candidate, repairing the active CFR-168 flow record, and adding negative tests for every accepted adversarial mutation.

risk.rationale: This is the control plane that decides throughput, routing, quality, continuity, and provider-cost policy; a partial validator or misleading exemplar would multiply incorrect decisions across all later development.

disallowed_actions: Run Cargo, build, install, demo, broad product Python suites, or network calls
Split the semantic validator, policy, exemplar, and negative tests into independently acceptable partial candidates
Claim a baseline, target, zero safety result, cost total, or KGI achievement without decision-grade evidence
Treat commit count, agent runtime, token volume, or unique_artifact_count as delivery success
Invent evidence, runtime metadata, cohort membership, provider cost, or unavailable measurements
Edit the independent review, issue state, product source, or user-owned worktree changes

non_goals: Change CodeFire product behavior or CFR-168 product candidates
Review the devcontainer, CI, packaging, host resources, or agent wrapper implementation
Establish a fabricated five-packet baseline from the current incomplete recovery batch
Run release, install, dogfood, Cargo, or broad product test gates
Redesign unrelated task, review, context-manifest, or routing contracts

invariants.statement: Every structurally valid but semantically misleading mutation enumerated in review section 5.1 is rejected with a stable finding while the repaired exemplar passes.
invariants.falsification_test: Run the repository negative-test matrix for all 55 semantic mutations and assert each produces the expected semantic finding; run the positive reference record through both schema and semantic validation.

invariants.statement: No KGI, cohort comparison, throughput claim, cost total, rate, or zero-target safety result can become authoritative without resolved measurements and evidence of the required status, unit, interval, and denominator.
invariants.falsification_test: Remove or forge each binding, set unavailable values to zero, create zero denominators, omit safety rows, and claim KGI achievement; each case must fail closed.

invariants.statement: All stage and event semantics derive the canonical Discover, Freeze, Plan, Implement, Close, Install, Dogfood, Retrospect lifecycle and make queue, review, integration, conflict, and completion intervals computable.
invariants.falsification_test: Create a record with an unknown stage, missing lane/event endpoint, reversed interval, or lifecycle-complete event before prior stages; semantic validation must reject it.

invariants.statement: Every repository-local commit, document, lane, event, measurement, evidence prefix, candidate, artifact, and supersession reference resolves to a unique bound subject.
invariants.falsification_test: Inject dangling, duplicate, non-hex, zero-byte, wrong-filename, and unresolved references and assert stable rejection findings.

invariants.statement: Recommitting, splitting commits, omitting slow open work, leaving metrics in progress, or selecting a denominator cannot improve the measured KGI/KPI outcome.
invariants.falsification_test: Mutate candidate lineage, cohort censoring, due dates, artifact identity, and MET-FLOW-019 membership and assert that validation refuses the gamed record.

invariants.statement: The CFR-168 recovery record distinguishes measured, estimated, unavailable, absent, and in-progress facts and does not claim decision readiness that current evidence cannot support.
invariants.falsification_test: Recompute every recorded duration/rate and resolve every repository-local reference; reject any value that contradicts its definition, including resumed-start understatement and cumulative-token-as-window-delta.

validation.purpose: Exercise the complete positive and negative contract matrix, including every independent-review mutation.
Validate all repository AI contracts and the repaired active flow record.
Run the bounded AI-development aggregate gate after semantic validation is integrated.
Keep the KGI/KPI policy, lifecycle, indexes, Phase-2 promotion record, and history consistent.
